summary_1line: Rama, camped by the sea before the assault on Lanka, laments Sita’s suffering and longs for reunion while speaking sorrowfully to Lakshmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands on the moonlit seashore with Lakshmana beside him, gazing over the waves while speaking of Sita with visible sorrow.
Rama lifts his face to the wind and pleads with the breeze to touch Sita and then return to him with her scent.
The vast monkey army rests along the northern shore while sentinels Mainda and Dvivida patrol the coastline under a dim sky.
